artworks.title: Portrait of Miss Jones
artworks.medium: photogravure on chine collé mounted on white paper and on dark gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, seated upright and facing the camera. The individual has dark, wavy hair and wears an ornate hat with feathers and flowers. They have a high-collared blouse with a white scarf, and a patterned jacket with stars. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Grand Garde (Souvenir du siège de Paris)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cloaked figure in a rural setting. In the foreground, there is a figure cloaked in heavy fabric, navigating rugged terrain with a stick in hand. The background features a small structure with classical columns and a symmetrical facade. The landscape includes barren trees, overgrown foliage, and planks arranged as a bridge. The line work shows attention to detail in capturing textures of natural elements and the figure's attire.

artworks.title: Dodo Arranging Her Hair
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body line drawing of a person seated on a chair. The person is in a semi-profile view, with their head turned slightly to the side. Their facial features are delicately sketched, with subtle details indicating closed eyes and a neutral expression. The individual's hair is drawn in short strokes, suggesting a tousled style. They appear to be adjusting their hair with both hands. The person is wearing a flowing garment that drapes around their form. The legs are highlighted with patterned stockings or leggings. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background features a textured surface with abstract shapes and shading.

artworks.title: Karnak (Thèbes), Palais--Salle hypostyle--Colonnade Centrale--Décoration d'un Fut
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George and Alexandra Stephanopoulos
artworks.description: The sculpture is a relief carving on a large stone column. The relief depicts human figures in profile wearing ancient Egyptian attire and headwear. Hieroglyphics are carved around and alongside the figures. The material is stone, with a light sandy beige color. The figures are depicted in a formal, stylized manner typical of Egyptian art.

artworks.title: Barcha del Hercole
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ship with mythical decorations. The ship is adorned with dragon figureheads emitting smoke or steam. Figures in ancient armor line the sides, some holding spears upright. The deck is crowded with these figures. The stern is elevated with grand carvings, featuring a figure with a staff. Minimal detail is given to the water. The drawing has a historical period interpretation with a strong linear quality typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Anfione Argon condotto da Mercurio
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological ship. The drawing depicts a fantastical vessel adorned with ornate sculptures and decorations. A figure labeled "Mercurio" is shown standing at the prow of the ship with a winged helmet and caduceus. Another figure, "Anfone," is depicted at the stern in armor holding a scepter. The ship is populated with figures in classical attire, holding shields and banners. Smoke or mist surrounds the ship as it glides over the water, with distant landscapes visible in the background.

artworks.title: Capitana del Armata de Colco
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a naval scene with an ornate ship. The ship is a galleon with detailed carvings and decorations on its hull. Oars are in the water, indicating motion. Figures on the deck are shown engaging in various activities, such as holding flags and operating cannons. Some figures are depicted firing cannons, creating clouds of smoke. The mast is adorned with ropes, adding to the dynamic energy of the scene. The text "CAPITANA DEL ARMATA DE COLCO" is featured below the image.

artworks.title: Reale dell'Armata di Argonuti con da Minerves
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of an ancient ship with ornate designs. The hull is adorned with various decorative elements, and the horizon is low in the image. The artwork features detailed and intricate lines, resembling an engraving. The color scheme is primarily sepia, giving the image a historical feel. Figures in armor and helmets are on the ship, and an animal figurehead is at the bow. Two smaller boats are visible in the distance, adding depth to the scene. The background is minimal, directing focus to the detailed ship and its passengers.

artworks.title: Calai e Zeti condotti da Borea et Oritia
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a fantasy sea voyage with classical mythology influences. The artwork features a ship-like structure sailing across a body of water, adorned with dragon or serpent figureheads. The vessel is occupied by warriors or mythological figures carrying spears and shields, dressed in elaborate ancient attire. There are trees and hybrid figures on board the ship. Two seated figures named Borea and Orithia overlook the scene from a rocky outcrop. Inscribed at the bottom is the text, "CALAI E ZETI CONDOTTI DA BOREA ET ORITIA," referring to the mythological characters Calais and Zetes. The drawing showcases intricate line work and detailing, creating a mythic and adventurous tableau.

artworks.title: Barcha de Castor e Poluce
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate ancient ship. The drawing depicts a large, elaborately decorated vessel with intricate carvings and figures. The ship is adorned with mythological influences and what appear to be mythological creatures or deities, labeled as "Castor" and "Poluce." The ship has a high stern and bow adorned with sculptures, including horses and classical figures. Oars extend from the sides of the ship, indicating it is a rowing vessel, and the mast is adorned with banners and rigging.

artworks.title: Peleo et Talamone Argonauti condotti da Tetide
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with a detailed ship. It features an elaborate ship adorned with ornate decorations and mythical elements. Intricate carvings decorate the hull and a figurehead resembling fantastical creatures. Armored figures are positioned at the front holding shields and spears. A central mast stands tall with branches rather than sails. Additional figures are depicted towards the back in dynamic poses, some holding staffs or spears. The water reflects the movement of the oars, indicating motion, with a natural environment in the background. The composition blends mythology and maritime culture with finely detailed linework typical of traditional engravings.

artworks.title: Polifemo e Palemonio Argonauti condotti da Cerere
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and a ship in a mythological scene. The image features elaborately dressed figures on a vessel with a central mast, surrounded by complex rock formations. More figures are seen on the rocks. The ship includes rowers and there is attention to detail in the figures and maritime environment. There are labels above some figures and settings, such as "Polifemo," "Paleomonio," and "Cerere."

artworks.title: Hiclo e Naucleo Argon condotti nel carro di Nettuno
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures standing on a mythical creature in the water. They are surrounded by other mythical creatures pulling a chariot with a figure holding a trident. The scene is detailed with linework, water motion, and rocky formations.

artworks.title: Agamennone et Menelao argn condoti da Vulcano
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient ship with warriors aboard. The ship is adorned with carvings on its hull, sporting a large sail and rows of oarsmen. Onboard, armored figures are depicted, with a seated figure labelled "Vulcano" holding a hammer. Two other figures, named "Agamemnon" and "Menelaos," are seated at the center. The prow of the ship is elaborately decorated with an ornate figurehead. The background shows coastal architecture with a structure on a cliff.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Woman Looking Down
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 30.9 x 23.2 cm (12 3/16 x 9 1/8 in.)
overall (2nd framing line): 23.5 x 16.6 cm (9 1/4 x 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips, in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is slightly facing left, with their head tilted downwards, eyes looking down, and lips closed. They have delicate facial features, including softly arched brows, long eyelashes, and a faint blush on the cheeks. Their hair is styled in loose curls with small flower adornments. The person is wearing a light-colored garment with a draped neckline and a darker overcoat with a rose flower pinned to it on the left side. The background is a simple, textured gray pattern, framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing in a contemplative pose, with his left hand raised to hold a book or scroll. He wears a long robe, sandals, and is surrounded by a stone archway. In the background, there is an ancient, ruined colonnade, lush trees, and a partly cloudy sky. The text "SVAVIUS INVE" is displayed in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork is a detailed scene with a variety of elements across the landscape. The horizon features rolling hills and a distant mountain. The sky has swirling patterns, possibly suggesting clouds and a full moon. The composition has intricate brushstrokes or etching lines, creating texture. The color palette is black and white. Closest to us, a cart with oxen and human figures travels on a rugged path. Figures and vegetation are highly detailed. The landscape extends into the distance with more trees and terrain.

artworks.title: A Landscape with a Village
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a distant church spire and rolling hills. The detailed brushstrokes create textures and shading in black, white, and gray tones. A shepherd rests on a rock, surrounded by a flock of sheep. The scene includes fields, trees, and swirling cloud patterns in the sky.

artworks.title: Marie de Medici
artworks.artist: Pieter van Sompel and Attributed to Pieter Claesz Soutman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person staring directly forward. The individual has distinct facial features, including a broad forehead, prominent eyes, a straight nose, full cheeks, and a lightly closed mouth. Their medium-length wavy hair has styled bangs above the eyebrows. They are wearing an ornate garment with layered fabric around the shoulders and a floral accessory pinned at the chest. The portrait is framed by an elaborate decorative border with detailed botanical motifs. The background is dark, emphasizing the figure's face and intricate surroundings. Inscription, cherubic figures, and a decorative scroll element are at the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: John, Count of Nassau
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in an ornate oval frame. The man's upper body and head are displayed, with his torso slightly angled. His facial features are detailed, with a high forehead, bushy eyebrows, large eyes, a pronounced mustache, and a small goatee. He has tight curls close to the scalp. He is dressed in elaborate attire with a lacy, ruffled collar, and a patterned garment with an insignia or decoration across the chest. The border around him is intricately designed with carvings of fruit, floral motifs, and foliage. The background includes fruit and vegetables. The lower portion of the engraving has a Latin inscription detailing the man's titles, surrounded by emblems of nobility and decoration.

artworks.title: L'Ange anatomique (The Anatomical Angel) or Dissection of a Woman's Back
artworks.description: This print shows the upper body of a person facing away from us, with a focus on their back and shoulders. The person is turning their head towards the right in a profile view. Their short brown hair is pulled back and held in place with a blue headband. On their neck, back, and shoulders, the individual's pale skin is peeled back to reveal anatomical muscle structures, with red and white markings indicating detailed layers of muscles and ribs. The background is a plain grey color.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman Looking Down
artworks.medium: chalk manner and tool work, printed in red, black, and blue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in honor of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a person. The individual is in a three-quarter profile, with their head tilted down and slightly to the side. They have delicate facial features, closed eyes, and slightly parted lips. Their hair is long, wavy, and dark, held back by a headband. The person wears a light-colored garment with a dark, draped cloth around their shoulders. The background is softly shaded in neutral tones, with a teal-colored border framing the person's head.

artworks.title: Idinone ea Mopso Argonoti guidati da Apollo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical ship with ornamental details. The image depicts an elaborately designed ship with a dragon-headed prow, featuring intricate patterns and multiple figures adorned with classical attire. Several individuals are on board and they hold various positions and gestures, adding a dynamic composition to the scene. Above them, a representation of Apollo is seated on a high and decorative structure at the ship's stern. The ship itself is artistically rendered with attention to ornamental details.

artworks.title: Atalata condoti da Diana
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological ship scene. The drawing depicts a large, ornate ship with intricate carvings and decorations, adorned with figures in classical attire along its deck. The ship is set on a body of water, its oars aligned in neat rows. At the rear, a figure labeled "Diana" is prominently positioned, seated on a cloud-like form. Another figure labeled "Atalanta" stands on the ship, gripping a shield, with others in various heroic poses, holding weapons and insignia. The waves below give an impression of movement. The detailed line work and shading enhance the grandeur and sophistication of the composition.
